delivery_audit.development_note: The fixed six-profile matrix passed on its first attempt. No child timed out and no fixture, timeout or source was changed to obtain PASS.
self_audit: Retained raw-pair capacity includes exact zeros, while compact RAM count includes only nonzero differences; excess drain changes neither population nor sign/zero diagnostics.
All-zero and all-masked prefixes set no-nonzero independently of overflow; a nonzero excess pair cannot repair that error.
Each signed input is extended to DATA_W+1 before x-y; abs(d)<=2^DATA_W-1 fits unsigned DATA_W even for full signed extrema.
Rank2=2*less+equal+1 includes the target itself in equal. Since equal>=1 and less+equal<=n, rank2 lies in2..2*n and all sign sums fit n*(n+1).
Tie membership increments once per target exactly when its magnitude group has more than one member; zero differences never participate.
Synchronous target/scan reads share one port and are consumed after registration; collection and replay are disjoint; reset makes stale compact suffixes unreachable.

All nine phases, middle/last target and inner scans, actual held normal/error output plus blocked source, overflowing zero prefixes and retained-zero collection have immediate reset and complete analytic fresh recovery checks.
Fresh full-range opposite-sign differences check both subtraction signs, exact half-rank ties and no stale output; the singleton checks the full-range negative difference.
Every main frame checks exact first-valid delay; valid main frames check exactly n rank accumulations and n*n magnitude comparisons.
No synthesis, PnR, STA, board work, expanded regression, staging, commit or shared-file edit was performed.

packaging.scope: Peer review corrected README wording: capacity-bounded random frames can still be all-zero and rejected. README-only source change and hash-only report/receipt refresh; RTL, TB, runner, oracle, fixtures, vectors and qualified commands/results unchanged; no numerical rerun.
